name: Landslide Across the Plains

npcs.name: Kuya Ben
dialogue: Typhoon rain and floodwater have weakened the hillside above the monitoring station. It is slipping.
Use the stable detour and report the blocked farm road to the response team.
after_dialogue: The route is clear enough for the team. No one should cross the fresh slide.

choice.prompt: The research team is near a moving slope. What is safest?

options.text: Use the stable detour and report their location
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.result: A fresh slide can move again without warning.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Dr. Elena Reyes
dialogue: My station recorded a pulse just before the slope failed. These notes bear Dr. Elias Voss's name.
I hurt my leg. Please bring the first-aid kit; the facility records may explain the pulse.
after_dialogue: Thank you. The readings show the machine sent a pulse before the landslide.
rescue_dialogue: I hurt my leg. Please bring the first-aid kit so I can get to safety.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the evacuation route now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the first-aid kit and talk to Dr. Elena Reyes again.

quests.title: Find the emergency radio for route updates
Collect a first-aid kit for the stranded researcher
Check the safe route with Kuya Ben
Help Dr. Elena Reyes reach safety
Leave a first-aid kit for responders

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety. During shaking: Drop, Cover, Hold On.

quests.community: Find Kuya Ben and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach Sturdy Shelter and stay clear of danger.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Learn local landslide warning signs, hazard maps, and evacuation routes before heavy rain.
If a slide threatens, avoid its path and move to a safe area as directed by local officials.
After a slide, stay away from the affected slope because further movement may occur.

quiz.question: You see signs of a possible landslide near your route. What is safest?
options: Avoid the slide path and move to a safe area following local instructions
Go closer to inspect the slope
Cross the debris to reach the road
quiz.explanation: Avoid landslide paths, move to a safe area, and follow local authority guidance.

briefing: Saturated hillsides trigger landslides along the route to the research facility. Keep out of unstable slopes, choose safe access, and help the stranded research team. Retrieve only records that can be reached without putting anyone at risk.
story_clue: A recovered file identifies Dr. Elias Voss as the machine’s creator.
